title: 大型連休中盤の松江市　「ばけばけ」効果で多くの観光客　あいにくの天気も雨の観光地楽しむ（島根）
extracted_text: 大型連休が中盤を迎えている5月3日、松江市内の観光地はあいにくの天気でしたが、ドラマ「ばけばけ」の効果もあり、多くの人出で賑わいました。 松江市は3日、前線や湿った空気の影響で天気がぐずつきましたが、松江城やその周辺の観光地では多くの人が傘を差しながら散策していました。 関係者によると、2026年の大型連休は、松江が舞台となった小泉八雲の妻・セツをモデルにしたドラマ「ばけばけ」の効果で、小泉八雲旧居をはじめとしたドラマゆかりの観光スポットが賑わっているということです。このうち堀川遊覧船では、行楽日和に恵まれた2日はおよそ1600人が利用しました。 山陰地方は4日までは天気が崩れるものの、5日以降は回復すると予想されていて、大型連休終盤のにぎわいに期待がかけられています。
translated_text: On May 3rd, when the long holiday reached its mid-point, tourist spots in Matsue City experienced inclement weather. However, due to the effect of the drama "Bakebake," the area was bustling with many visitors. On May 3rd, Matsue City saw cloudy weather due to the influence of a front and moist air. Nevertheless, many people could be seen strolling with umbrellas around Matsue Castle and nearby tourist spots. According to officials, during the 2026 long holiday, tourist spots associated with the drama "Bakebake" - which features Setsu, the wife of Koizumi Yakumo, as a model - have been bustling, including the Koizumi Yakumo Former Residence. On the Horikawa River cruise, approximately 1,600 people used the service on May 2nd, which had favorable weather for sightseeing. While weather in the San'in region is expected to remain unstable through May 4th, conditions are forecast to improve from May 5th onward, raising hopes for continued bustling activity during the latter half of the long holiday.
title_en: Matsue City bustling with tourists during mid-Golden Week thanks to "Bakebake" drama, rainy weather not dampening enjoyment of tourist spots (Shimane)
